scope: 100 remaining functional CoreFoundation entry bodies; placeholders and unimplemented runtime workers remain separate work

entries.name: CFAbsoluteTimeAddGregorianUnits
entries.abi_notes: Timezone r5, five unit integers r6..r10, seconds stack words 8/9; native month normalization and day clamp before addition. Preserves reference fused hour/minute operation order.
remaining_workers: non-null timezone/exception/nonfinite or overflowing calendar fallback

entries.name: CFAbsoluteTimeGetDayOfWeek
entries.abi_notes: Absolute time f1 occupies r3/r4; timezone r5. Native integer Gregorian calendar; week-of-year preserves the reference early-January constant-53 behavior.
remaining_workers: non-null timezone/exception/extreme-input fallback

entries.name: CFAbsoluteTimeGetDayOfYear
entries.abi_notes: Absolute time f1 occupies r3/r4; timezone r5. Native integer Gregorian calendar; week-of-year preserves the reference early-January constant-53 behavior.
remaining_workers: non-null timezone/exception/extreme-input fallback

entries.name: CFAbsoluteTimeGetDifferenceAsGregorianUnits
entries.abi_notes: Hidden 28-byte result; f1/f2 consume four parameter words; timezone r8 and flags r9. Native reference estimate/advance algorithm, unit flags and fused calendar addition. Bounded nonprogress and overflowing calendars preserve fallback before output publication.
remaining_workers: non-null timezone/exception/extreme/nonprogress fallback

entries.name: CFAbsoluteTimeGetGregorianDate
entries.abi_notes: Hidden result r3; double f1 consumes r4/r5; timezone r6. Native Gregorian decomposition, modulo arithmetic and packed 16-byte result.
remaining_workers: non-null timezone/exception/extreme-input fallback

entries.name: CFAbsoluteTimeGetWeekOfYear
entries.abi_notes: Absolute time f1 occupies r3/r4; timezone r5. Native integer Gregorian calendar; week-of-year preserves the reference early-January constant-53 behavior.
remaining_workers: non-null timezone/exception/extreme-input fallback

entries.name: CFBSearch
entries.abi_notes: Key, element size, base, count, comparator, context. Short arrays compare in descending index order. Larger arrays reverse the low endpoint comparison and then search with descending powers of two.

entries.name: CFCharacterSetCompact
entries.abi_notes: Native 65536-bit scan, compact run/single representation and reference summary masks. Host snapshot is never exposed to PPC; replacement allocation completes before publishing. Allocation failure preserves old representation.
remaining_workers: Initialized reference bit-mask table at TOC+0x3964; allocator callbacks

entries.name: CFCharacterSetFast
entries.abi_notes: Only reference compact form 0x40 is converted. Publishes allocated guest bitmap and clears inversion bit 0x8; allocation/callback failures retain prior storage.
remaining_workers: Real representation-to-bitmap worker 0x2fbf4; allocator callbacks

entries.name: CFCopyTypeIDDescription
remaining_workers: string construction and live class registry

entries.name: CFDateCreate
entries.abi_notes: Allocator in r3, absolute time raw IEEE bits in f1; no host FP conversion.
remaining_workers: initialized native CF runtime allocation and class callbacks

entries.name: CFGregorianDateGetAbsoluteTime
entries.abi_notes: Four-word by-value Gregorian struct and timezone r7; native integer Gregorian day calculation and PPC-ordered arithmetic. Non-null timezones, nonfinite/extreme values and enabled exceptions preserve reference fallback.
remaining_workers: Native PPC arithmetic; non-null timezone/exception/extreme-input reference fallback

entries.name: CFGregorianDateIsValid
entries.abi_notes: Gregorian struct by value in four GPR words, flags fifth word ignored by reference. Ordered comparisons preserve the reference NaN result/status; enabled exceptions retain complete-frame fallback.
remaining_workers: Native PPC SoftFloat arithmetic; enabled-exception frame fallback

entries.name: CFHashBytes
entries.abi_notes: ELF/PJW byte hash with unsigned wrap; nonpositive CFIndex length produces zero.

entries.name: CFLog
entries.abi_notes: Native process-prefix caching and variadic message orchestration; caller-owned argument homes preserve trailing PPC parameters and FP formatting state.
remaining_workers: Native Process Manager; native format/show entries; real renderer and printf worker

entries.name: CFMergeSortArray
entries.abi_notes: Private 1.4 ABI: incoming r6 is ignored; comparator/context come from r7/r8 before the worker tail call.

entries.name: CFQSortArray
entries.abi_notes: Comparator/context in r6/r7. Stable native merge ordering is valid for the quick-sort API; equal ordering is unspecified.

entries.name: CFShow
entries.abi_notes: Native description selection and chunked UTF-16 diagnostic output; preserves U+FFFF iterator terminator and ASCII/escaped output formats.
remaining_workers: Formatting description worker 0x537fc; description callbacks; reference fprintf import 0x58568 and stderr storage

entries.name: CFShowStr
entries.abi_notes: Native string-layout diagnostic fields; original printf formats and allocator/data/deallocator information preserved.
remaining_workers: String length/cache worker; deallocator-slot helpers 0x35414/0x35434; printf import 0x584e8

entries.name: CFStringAppendFormat
entries.abi_notes: Variadic words r6..r10 are homed at caller r1+36; later words are already contiguous.
remaining_workers: private format scanner/renderer 0x3ee90

entries.name: CFStringAppendFormatAndArguments
remaining_workers: private format scanner/renderer 0x3ee90

entries.name: CFStringCreateWithFormat
entries.abi_notes: Variadic GPR homes preserve integer, pointer and promoted floating argument words.
remaining_workers: native format-create auxiliary entry; original private format scanner

entries.name: CFStringCreateWithFormatAndArguments
remaining_workers: native format-create auxiliary entry; original private format scanner

entries.name: CFStringFileSystemEncoding
remaining_workers: native system encoding query; original TEC converter registry

entries.name: CFStringGetDoubleValue
remaining_workers: private decimal scanner 0x42fb0; string inline-buffer refill workers

entries.name: CFURLCreateDataAndPropertiesFromResource
entries.abi_notes: Native file-scheme validation, byte read and CFData ownership transfer. Read and property failures preserve reference error codes and independent outputs.
remaining_workers: Native File Manager byte reader; resource properties worker 0x3f04; CFData constructor

entries.name: CFURLCreatePropertyFromResource
entries.abi_notes: Native single-property array request and retained dictionary lookup; releases request and property dictionary on every path.
remaining_workers: Native data/property orchestration; resource properties worker 0x3f04

entries.name: CFURLCreateStringByAddingPercentEscapes
entries.abi_notes: Native public entry/context ABI; the shared percent-escape scanner and encoding worker remain real.
remaining_workers: Shared percent-escape worker 0x56fc; callback at TOC+0x3f0

entries.name: CFURLCreateStringByReplacingPercentEscapes
entries.abi_notes: Native percent triplet scan and replacement. Preserves reference first-character leave-set reuse, malformed-input NULL result, UTF-8 decoding limited to one UTF-16 unit and no-change copy behavior.
remaining_workers: UTF-8 CFString decoder and native string mutation workers

entries.name: CFURLDestroyResource
entries.abi_notes: Native scheme/path validation and native file/directory removal with reference error output.
remaining_workers: Native File Manager delete; URL path conversion

entries.name: CFURLWriteDataAndPropertiesToResource
entries.abi_notes: Native file/directory write orchestration. Non-null property dictionaries remain unsupported exactly as the reference 0x4468 worker; this is not native resource-property mutation.
remaining_workers: Native File Manager writers; string/path conversion; resource property writes unsupported by reference

entries.name: CFUUIDCreateWithBytes
entries.abi_notes: Allocator plus sixteen UInt8 arguments, including nine checked stack words; discard upper argument bits.
remaining_workers: original UUID interning worker 0x4b684

entries.name: CFUUIDGetConstantUUIDWithBytes
entries.abi_notes: Allocator plus sixteen UInt8 arguments, including nine checked stack words; discard upper argument bits.
remaining_workers: original UUID interning worker 0x4b684

entries.name: _CFAppendPathExtension

entries.name: _CFBundleGetCFMFunctionPointersForNames

entries.name: _CFProcessName

remaining_workers: Native process-path cache

entries.name: _CFProcessNameString

entries.name: _CFPropertyListCreateFromXMLData
entries.abi_notes: Native parser orchestration with XML-first/OpenStep-second behavior and reference 36-byte parser context. Checks extent/allocation failures and optional error output; releases temporary strings, allocator retains and secondary parser errors leaked on reference failure paths.
remaining_workers: Encoding detector 0x29c80; XML parser 0x29a84; OpenStep parser 0x2afc4; string decoders

entries.name: _CFReadBytesFromFile

remaining_workers: native File Manager open/seek/read/close; allocator callbacks; native URL/FSSpec entry

entries.name: _CFTransmutePathSlashes
